credibility.line: Management met FY26 growth and margin targets but FY27 promises remain unverified.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Mgmt said FY25‑26 revenue rose 16% to 27,480 cr; reported FY26 revenue 27,610 cr confirms claim.
Mgmt promised FY27 EBITDA 21‑23% but Sep 2026 margin is 28%, higher than promised range.
Mgmt highlighted strong order book (≈73,000 cr) yet no order‑inflow data to verify FY27 inflow targets.

bull: FY26 revenue grew 16% YoY, beating 15% guidance.
FY26 EBITDA margin hit 29%, above 27% target.
Operating cash flow turned positive in FY26 (1,541 cr).
bear: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance (21‑23%) appears lower than current 28% trend.
Order‑inflow targets for FY27 lack any disclosed evidence.
Profit after tax growth slowed to 4.7% YoY in FY26.
